content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-257. - Severability provision.
content.summary:

               thereof to any person or circumstance invalid, such invalidity shall not affect the

     …

faqs.a:
If a court of competent jurisdiction adjudges any provision of this article or application
               thereof to any person or circumstance invalid, such invalidity shall not affect the
               remaining provisions of this article that can be effective without the invalid provision,
               and to this end this article is declared to be severable.
(Code 1981, § 31-117; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
